name: Govee Output
description: Drive Govee lights in a Vixen show over Govee's LAN API: one colour per bulb, or per segment on strips that support DreamView streaming. Optionally hands the lights to the show through a Home Assistant Light Arbiter.
author: Braden Guliano

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: In output order: each device takes 3 outputs (R, G, B), or 3 per segment in Segments mode. Run Plugins ▸ Govee Output ▸ Suggest Devices to fill this in.

ip.title: Fixed IP (optional)
ip.description: Only if discovery can't reach it; otherwise found by id on every start.

haEntity.title: Home Assistant light (optional)
haEntity.description: The light entity the Light Arbiter knows it by.

brightness.title: Device brightness (%)
brightness.description: Set once when the show starts; the show's levels scale the colours under it.

maxFps.title: Updates per second per device
maxFps.description: Govee devices drop commands sent too fast; 20 is safe for most.

keepAliveMs.title: Resend unchanged colour every (ms)
keepAliveMs.description: Covers a lost UDP packet; 0 sends only on change.

gamma.title: Gamma
gamma.description: 1 sends levels as they are; above 1 deepens dim levels.

segmentBlend.title: Blend between segments
segmentBlend.description: The DreamView stream's gradient flag. Leave off for crisp segments.

onStop.title: When the show stops
x-enumNames: Put each light back as it was

homeAssistant.title: Home Assistant (Light Arbiter)
homeAssistant.description: Ask Home Assistant's light_acquire / light_release scripts for the lights, so automations don't fight the show. Needs a token in the plugin's data folder (see the README).

force.title: Force
force.description: Take lights even when someone else holds them.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Find Govee devices with LAN Control on, with their device ids and addresses (named from Home Assistant when a token is saved). Sends only a discovery broadcast; no light changes.

tools.name: suggest_devices
tools.description: A ready Devices table for a Govee controller covering every Govee light on the LAN, plus the outputs it needs. No light changes.

segments.description: Use Segments mode for strips that support it (default true).

tools.name: status
tools.description: Each Govee controller's devices: address, found or not, outputs, packets sent, and lights held through Home Assistant.

tools.name: identify
tools.description: Flash one real Govee light white three times, then put it back. Needs Live Output on.

tools.name: home_assistant_check
tools.description: Check the Home Assistant URL and saved token work (no changes in Home Assistant).
